description.zh: Secret实例所在命名空间ID。如果所在命名空间为默认命名空间，则只需填写RegionId，例如`cn-beijing`。
description.en: The ID of the namespace where the Secret resides. If the namespace is the default namespace, you need to only enter the region ID, such as `cn-beijing`.

description.zh: 查询的Secret实例ID。需要调用[ListSecrets](~~466929~~)接口查看。
description.en: The ID of the Secret instance to be queried. You can call the [ListSecrets](~~466929~~) operation to view the IDs of Secrete instances.
